run_train_ppo: run the PPO reinforcement learning training script with a specified config and log directory
create_environment: create a wrapped Gym environment with range normalization, action clipping, and 32-bit conversion
define_training_loop: define a training loop with train and eval phases using graph elements and step counts
train_rl_agent: train a reinforcement learning agent using PPO algorithm and yield evaluation scores per epoch
load_and_run_config: load a named config from configs module, save it, and launch the training loop
